thread.title: Apple Climbs Off Worst Levels But Remains Notably Lower

author: nasdaq.com
title: Apple Climbs Off Worst Levels But Remains Notably Lower
text:
Apple Climbs Off Worst Levels But Remains Notably Lower November 05, 2018, 02:20:00 PM Shares of Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) have climbed off their worst levels of the day but remain firmly in negative territory in afternoon trading on Monday. After hitting a three-month intraday low, Apple is currently down by 3 percent.
Apple initially extended the sell-off seen in the previous session after a report from Japan'sNikkei newspaper said demand for the company's iPhone XR appears to be disappointing.
Last Friday, Apple plummeted by 6.6 percent after the tech giant reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings and revenues that exceeded estimates but weaker than expected iPhone shipments.
Apple also forecast fiscal first quarter revenues of $89 to $93 billion, with the midpoint below the consensus estimate of $93 billion. Read the original article on RTTNews ( http://www.rttnews.com/2951605/apple-climbs-off-worst-levels-but-remains-notably-lower.aspx )
